mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aup_snapshot (aup_id, version_no, stage, draft_source, data, template_id, template_version, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{aupId}, #{versionNo}, #{stage}, #{draftSource}, #{data}, #{templateId}, #{templateVersion}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aup_snapshot WHERE id = #{id} AND aup_id = #{aupId}
SELECT id, aup_id, version_no, stage, draft_source, template_id, template_version, created_by, created_at FROM aup_snapshot WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM aup_snapshot WHERE aup_id = #{aupId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_snapshot WHERE aup_id = #{aupId}
